Soooo... that means I can come too, right?
Right? Take me with you♡ ...Take-me-with-youuu♡

That being said, as someone who took up billiards as a hobby,
I couldn't just keep losing. Even if she was a genius—

I wasn't quite sure what she meant by "sparkling"... but from the way things were going,
maybe Fusaichi Pandora wanted a hobby she could truly get passionate about.

Mm! Okey-dokey, let's try it~!!
Make sure you make me totally sparkle too, okay?♡

Hmm-mm-mm, so that's how it works. In that case...
I wanna give it a shot right now♪ Hey hey, lemme borrow your cue♡
I mean, it's not like this is my first time doing something like this~.

Whaaat! What's with that happy look on your face~?!
No fair, no fair, no fair!!

Huh! So clooose~!!
That ball was supposed to go in, right? Man, that was super close~!!

Wait, don't tell me that shot came from a complete beginner?!
...Excuse me! Young lady, may I have a word?!

Ah~, well, that's part of it right now, sure.
Even without that, I totally would've turned him down anyway.
(Clack! Roll-roll-roll-roll........................ Plop!)

Said the man in the suit as he handed over his business card.
According to the information printed on it, he was—

So you want to try something even newer?
With you? ...Hmmmm.

I've seen it played before, I guess?
So show me an example first! C'mon, c'mon~♪

So based on how today went, billiards is probably the same deal, right?
Or something like that.

Ehh~, seriously?! Gosh, I really am super popular after all~♡
......Well, but still.

...—Wait, huh? Are you going somewhere?
Wait, your bag is huge! And super long! What's inside~?

I readjusted what she called a "bag"—my pool cue case.
I had only started playing recently on a coworker's recommendation, but I was totally hooked.

Wait, what the! What was that just now... Huh, why?!
Just now, you looked, like, sooooo crazy sparkling?!
Sorry, but I'm gonna pass♡

You are destined to become a professional!
I know someone who's exceptional at coaching, so if you wouldn't mind...!

What the heck, why is it just you?! That's so not fair!
I wanna spa~rkle to~oooo~!!
Aiiim real carefully... Reaaally carefully...—Hup♡

F-For real?! Sinking the 9-ball on the break...
She's a beginner, right?! A break-and-run right off the bat, are you kidding me—
All I gotta do is sink this "9 ball", right? All righty♪

Yaaa-hoo~. I got so bored I came over.
Having my plans cancelled was totally ridiculous! Hey, pay attention to me, pay attention~!
Ooh!! Looking good! Just like that... just like that...—

In the end, she turned down the scout's offer.
He grumbled that "it was such a waste of talent," though...

Like when I tried oil painting on a whim,
I ended up winning 1st place in a competition somehow—

Oh, and I tried target shooting once, too.
My very first score beat the instructor's. And a bunch of other stuff—

Anyway, no matter what I try,
I get the hang of it right away, and then it gets boring right away. Every single time.

Like at a plushie sewing class...
On my very first day, mine was used as the model example—

Whoaaa~! It's so lively in here!!
I wanna hurry up and play too!!
